acceptanceResults.notes: SYS-API-027/038/039/040 exact paths, headers, statuses, closed schemas and dual receipt profiles pass. Approved OpenAPI snapshots cover 12 services and 1,740 Gateway paths; frontend API is 7/7.
Canonical catalog is 76 BASE76 plus 22 MODERN22 with 98 unique route keys and explicit ko/en labels; missing or colliding labels fail closed.

Initial People methods and four Auth-query methods failed; each smallest owning method passed after correction. Current PAGE, APP.HCM, shell duty, tenant, country, scope and field-policy reauthorization is server-derived; client role lists never grant.
Exact HCM PAGE decisions and literal sealed DWP_CONTROL targets pass; generic /admin and five undeployed external targets are absent.

The initial PostgreSQL class failed through the V327 migration. Six smallest failed methods then passed on real PostgreSQL; all four tables force tenant/principal RLS and receipt denial remains opaque.
Favorite bounds, If-Match CAS, exact idempotency replay, digest-conflict rejection and denied/retired purge pass after the migration-dependent smallest method corrections.
Recents preserve at most 20 unique authorized keys with server-time LRU, 30-day TTL, replay and purge; the migration-dependent concurrent trim failure passed its smallest rerun.
Shared receipts, stable exact replay, no-side-effect digest conflict and exact-origin RESULT_UNKNOWN reconciliation pass after phase-one and migration-dependent smallest corrections.
Minimized typed evidence and XCON-012 through XCON-015 composition cover happy, missing, stale, mismatch, timeout and unavailable paths; provider failure returns PARTIAL and never false empty.
Only governed hcm.utility /hr/explore and one exact-authorized Home secondary action are mounted; seven workbenches remain unchanged and HrisProductMap is absent.

The initial Explorer Vitest scope passed the query-state owner tests while the separate route test was the only failure. URL restoration, all material states, keyboard/focus, responsive themes, forced colors, reduced motion and long ko/en labels pass in the pinned browser evidence. Nonblocking P2: labels are materially long but literal longest locale strings are not independently proven.

V327 clean and V326-to-V327 upgrade pass after smallest PostgreSQL method corrections, prior checksums remain intact, responsive/200% zoom and path integrity pass, and v43/runtime remain DRAFT/default OFF.

  libs/shared-i18n/src/locales/ko/hcm.json | LC_ALL=C sort)
actual_paths=$({ git diff --name-only; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | LC_ALL=C sort -u)
{
  echo "command=git diff --check + exact 20-path allowlist + generated mirror/content hashes"
  echo "started_at=$started_at"
  git diff --check
  diff_rc=$?
  echo "diff_check_exit=$diff_rc"
  actual_count=$(printf '%s\n' "$actual_paths" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
  echo "changed_path_count=$actual_count"
  if [ "$actual_paths" = "$expected_paths" ]; then
    echo "allowlist=PASS"
    allow_rc=0
  else
    echo "allowlist=FAIL"
    echo "actual_paths:"
    printf '%s\n' "$actual_paths"
    allow_rc=1
  fi
  git diff --quiet -- libs/api-contracts/src/gateway-public.ts
  ts_rc=$?
  echo "generated_ts_diff_exit=$ts_rc"
  echo "gateway_json_numstat=$(git diff --numstat -- libs/api-contracts/openapi/gateway-public.json)"
  echo "gateway_json_delta:"
  git diff -U0 -- libs/api-contracts/openapi/gateway-public.json | rg '^[+-].*x-dwp-purpose-code' || true
  echo "content_hashes:"
  while IFS= read -r changed_path; do
    [ -n "$changed_path" ] || continue
    content_hash=$(shasum -a 256 "$changed_path" | awk '{print $1}')
    content_bytes=$(stat -f %z "$changed_path")
    echo "$content_hash $content_bytes $changed_path"
  done <<EOF
$actual_paths
EOF
  echo "branch=$(git branch --show-current)"
  echo "head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
  echo "upstream=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name '@{upstream}')"
  echo "ahead_behind=$(git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD')"
  final_rc=$diff_rc
  if [ "$allow_rc" -ne 0 ]; then final_rc=$allow_rc; fi
  if [ "$ts_rc" -ne 0 ]; then final_rc=$ts_rc; fi
  echo "exit_code=$final_rc"
  echo "finished_at=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
} >"$evidence_log" 2>&1
rc=$?
echo "$evidence_log"
cat "$evidence_log"
exit $rc
